crosswalk_row_encoding: Keys are SHA256 of UTF-8 compact JSON cells (ensure_ascii=false), not raw line hashes. Values retain every parsed crosswalk column. Per-occurrence indexes retain duplicate rows and every exact native lookup key. Native defaults are denominator=aggregate, exclude_unnamed=true; native_result carries its actual denominator, not a strain count. Index rows precede native rank/name filtering.
limitation: Native mapping/status computation only. No source interpretation, stock identity, candidate approval, application, validation gates or scientific clearance. All options and null results are retained; existing blocks/manual holds are passed to the classifier unchanged. NCBI database provenance is file stat only.
